name: Chapter label pill (top-left)
description: A small dark rounded label at the top-left over the speaker: an orange circle with the chapter number and a spaced uppercase name ('01  DIY EDITING'). It slides in, then stays still for the whole section; optionally, near the end, the name is struck through and greyed and a small orange chip like '× TOO SLOW' pops in beside it.
use_when: Lay it over a whole section while the speaker talks through one option, step or approach; add done_text when the section ends by rejecting that option ('too slow', 'headache', 'too expensive').

number.help: chapter number shown in the orange circle, e.g. '01'; empty hides the circle

done_text.help: verdict chip that appears at the end and strikes the label, e.g. 'too slow' (the × is added); empty = no strike

done_at.help: when the verdict appears, as a fraction of the scene (0-1); 0.75 = three quarters in
